title: Forgotten internet-banking passwords and usernames - support procedure
content: Choose Forgot password or Forgot username on the verified banking portal and complete its private verification process yourself. This assistant can explain the steps without seeing a password, PIN, CVV or OTP; stop if an unsolicited caller asks for them.
